items.name: 黄尾鲴
items.form: a thin axillary scale that does not reach the anus
items.fins: pectoral fins with one stout spine and 15 to 16 rays reaching the front of the pelvic fin origin, an anal fin with three stout spines and 9 to 11 rays, a forked tail fin

items.name: 赤眼鳟
items.form: an elongated cylindrical body, the posterior part somewhat flattened, a conical head, a blunt snout, no ventral keel, a terminal arcuate mouth, two pairs of tiny vestigial barbels on the upper jaw, medium-sized eyes set near the tip of the snout, large round scales, a straight lateral line running to the middle of the caudal peduncle
items.fins: a short dorsal fin without a spine, a short anal fin below and behind the dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 大眼华鳊
items.form: a laterally compressed slightly elongated body, the back slightly elevated, a small head, no barbels, large eyes, a short blunt snout, a keeled belly from the pelvic fin base to the anus, medium-sized scales, a complete lateral line
items.fins: a forked tail fin

items.name: 似鳊
items.form: a laterally compressed body, a relatively high back, a rounded belly, a very narrow ventral keel from the pelvic fin base to the anus, a short head, a rounded blunt snout, a small inferior mouth with a transverse slit, thin lips, larger scales, a slender axillary scale at the pelvic fin base
items.fins: a dorsal fin with a smooth stout spine shorter than the head

items.name: 中华细鲫
items.form: larger scales, an incomplete lateral line reaching only to above the middle of the pectoral fins
items.fins: longer pectoral fins reaching the origin of the pelvic fins, pelvic fins reaching the anus, a relatively long anal fin without a spine, a forked tail fin with two lobes about equal in length

items.name: 麦鲮
items.form: an elongated spindle-shaped body, slightly laterally compressed, body depth about equal to head length, round medium-sized scales, a complete lateral line

items.name: 鲈鲤
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a large pointed head, a large terminal mouth, small eyes, small scales
items.fins: a forked tail fin

items.name: 鲤鱼
items.form: no teeth in the jaws, pharyngeal teeth in the throat used for chewing

items.name: 鲈鱼
items.form: an elongated slightly laterally compressed body, the lower jaw slightly longer than the upper, small ctenoid scales
items.fins: two dorsal fins joined at the base, an anal fin with a smaller first spine and a stronger second spine

items.name: 翘嘴鲌
items.form: a slender laterally compressed willow-leaf-shaped body, a medium-sized head, an incomplete ventral keel from the pelvic fin base to the anus, a relatively long caudal peduncle, small cycloid scales, a complete lateral line

items.name: 蒙古鲌
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a pointed head, an upturned mouth, an incomplete ventral keel, small scales, a complete lateral line
items.fins: a forked tail fin

items.name: 鳡鱼
items.form: a large terminal mouth with the cleft reaching below the eye, a bony knob at the front of the lower jaw, small eyes, fine scales
items.fins: pectoral fins not reaching the pelvic fins, pelvic fins not reaching the anal fin, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 刺鲃
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a conical head, an inferior mouth, two pairs of barbels, medium-sized scales, a complete lateral line
items.fins: a dorsal fin with a stout spine

items.name: 大眼鳜
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, the chest and belly outlines curved, round scales, the head and back outlines raised, a large terminal slightly oblique mouth, small scales on the gill cover

items.name: 长吻鮠
items.form: a spindle-shaped body, a rounded belly, a laterally compressed tail, smooth scaleless skin, a straight lateral line, well-developed mucus glands
items.fins: a dorsal fin with two spines and 6 to 7 rays, an anal fin with 14 to 18 rays, pectoral fins with one spine and 9 rays, pelvic fins with 6 rays

items.name: 中华倒刺鲃
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, the back elevated in a curve, a conical head, eyes set on the sides and widely spaced, a subinferior mouth, a blunt snout protruding slightly forward, two pairs of barbels, larger scales, a complete lateral line

items.name: 银鮈
items.form: an elongated slender body, a complete lateral line with 38 to 41 scales
items.fins: a dorsal fin with 7 branched rays, an anal fin with 6 branched rays, pectoral fins with one spine and 14 to 16 rays, pelvic fins with one spine and 7 to 8 rays

items.name: 湖心巨鲤
items.form: a deep oval body with a rounded belly, a large blunt head, a small terminal mouth, two pairs of long barbels at the mouth corners, large cycloid scales
items.fins: a long-based dorsal fin, a short anal fin, a large forked tail fin

items.name: 百斤鳡王
items.form: a long slender pike-like body, a pointed conical head, a large terminal mouth, the lower jaw slightly protruding, rows of sharp teeth, small scales
items.fins: a long dorsal fin, pointed pectoral fins, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 溪哥
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a small head, a blunt rounded snout, a large oblique mouth, small scales, a complete lateral line, the male with nuptial tubercles on the snout

items.name: 马口鱼
items.form: an elongated slightly compressed body, a hump behind the head, a narrow caudal peduncle, a rounded belly, a large rounded head, a short broad snout with a pointed tip, a large wide terminal mouth sloping downward, a pair of short barbels at the corners of the mouth, fine small scales
items.fins: the first to fourth branched anal fin rays elongated in males, nuptial tubercles on the head, pectoral and anal fins in the breeding season

items.name: 宽鳍鱲
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a pointed head, a terminal mouth, no barbels, medium-sized scales, a complete lateral line
items.fins: a forked tail fin

items.name: 拉氏鱥
items.form: a subterminal mouth, medium-sized eyes, very small scales, a complete lateral line
items.fins: a short small dorsal fin, oval pectoral fins, a slightly concave tail fin

items.name: 小鳈
items.form: a small slightly elongated body, a slightly arched back, a small head, a short blunt snout, a very small inferior mouth, small eyes, a pair of very fine barbels at the corners of the mouth, a straight lateral line
items.fins: a dorsal fin with no spines and long rays, its outer margin flat or slightly convex; short pectoral fins with rounded rear edges; pelvic fins set slightly behind the dorsal fin origin with rounded rear edges; an anal fin with a flat outer margin; a shallowly forked tail fin with slightly rounded lobe tips

items.name: 黑鳍鳈
items.form: a small elongated slightly compressed body, a rather short caudal peduncle, a rounded belly, a rather small head

items.name: 棒花鱼
items.form: a cylindrical anterior body, a flattened rounded posterior body, a flat belly, a raised back, a slightly rounded forward-projecting snout, thick developed lips, superior eyes, a wide interorbital space, small eyes, cycloid scales, a straight lateral line, no scales on the breast below the pectoral fins

items.name: 似鮈
items.form: a complete lateral line
items.fins: long pectoral fins

items.name: 间下鱵
items.form: an elongated slender body, a lower jaw extended into a beak about as long as the head, a short small upper jaw with a triangular scaled tip, fine teeth on the jaws, cycloid scales, a low lateral line with an upward branch beneath the base of the pectoral fin
items.fins: a dorsal fin with 13 to 16 soft rays, an anal fin with 15 to 19 soft rays set opposite and behind the dorsal fin, the anal fin origin below the first to third dorsal rays; short pectoral fins; short small pelvic fins; a shallowly forked tail fin with the lower lobe slightly longer than the upper

items.name: 光唇鱼
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, an inferior arcuate mouth, a straight front edge of the lower jaw, two pairs of barbels, medium-sized scales, a nearly straight lateral line
items.fins: a dorsal fin with a spine bearing fine serrations on its rear edge

items.name: 缨口鳅
items.form: a slender flattened body, a depressed head, a blunt rounded snout, an inferior mouth with fleshy fringed lips, barbels at the corners of the mouth, small scales, a complete lateral line
items.fins: the pectoral and pelvic fins broad and spread out to grip the substrate, a low dorsal fin

items.name: 褐鳟
items.form: an elongated spindle-shaped body, a medium-sized head, a short blunt snout, a terminal mouth, small cycloid scales, a complete lateral line
items.fins: a single dorsal fin with a small adipose fin behind it, a slightly forked tail fin

items.name: 溪石斑
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a small head, a blunt rounded snout, an inferior mouth with a horny lower lip, barbels at the corners of the mouth, ctenoid scales, a complete lateral line

items.name: 唇䱻
items.form: a rather large head, large eyes, an inferior horseshoe-shaped mouth, developed gill rakers, small scales, a complete lateral line
items.fins: the last unbranched dorsal fin ray soft; no spine in the pectoral fins; pelvic fins set slightly behind the dorsal fin origin; a rather long anal fin reaching almost to the base of the tail fin; a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 白甲鱼
items.form: a spindle-shaped laterally compressed body, a short broad head, a blunt forward-projecting snout, a rather wide arcuate mouth, a naked lower jaw with a sharp horny front edge, a complete lateral line, a rather high caudal peduncle

items.name: 山女鳟
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, small scales covering the body except the head, relatively large eyes, a protruding beak-like snout, a terminal mouth, upper and lower jaws not meeting
items.fins: a dorsal fin set far back, short small pectoral fins, pelvic fins set far from the pectoral fins, a crescent-shaped tail fin

items.name: 台湾铲颌鱼
items.form: a moderately elongated body about three to four times as long as deep, a head about one fifth of the body length, a snout about one third of the head length, a caudal peduncle about twice as long as deep, 45 to 47 scales along the lateral line
items.fins: a dorsal fin with 4 spines and 8 soft rays, an anal fin with 3 spines and 5 soft rays, pectoral fins with 14 to 16 rays, pelvic fins with 2 spines and 8 to 9 rays

items.name: 中华刺鳅
items.form: a pointed elongated head, a long pointed snout tip, round large protruding eyes, a spine in front of the eye, small scales covering the body, 29 to 36 spines along the back, 3 sharp spines behind the genital opening
items.fins: the dorsal, anal and tail fins joined continuously

items.name: 福建小鳔鮈
items.form: an elongated slightly compressed body, a small head, a blunt rounded snout, an inferior mouth, a pair of barbels at the corners of the mouth, small scales, a complete lateral line

items.name: 溪灵·金线鲃
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a pointed slender snout, eyes set at the middle of the sides of the head, many sensory pores on the head forming lines, enlarged scales along the lateral line
items.fins: a forked tail fin, a dorsal fin with a serrated bony spine, the outer margin of the dorsal fin slightly concave or truncate, the last unbranched dorsal ray thick and hard at the base with a serrated rear edge and a soft segmented tip, the dorsal fin origin slightly behind the pelvic fin origin

items.name: 麦穗鱼
items.form: a slightly depressed anterior body, a small superior mouth with a nearly vertical gape, thin lips, no barbels
items.fins: a dorsal fin with soft unbranched rays and no spines, the dorsal fin origin slightly behind the pelvic fin origin, short small pectoral and pelvic fins, a forked tail fin

items.name: 白条
items.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a slightly arched back, a small pointed head, an upward-directed mouth, no barbels, cycloid scales, a complete lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
items.fins: a short dorsal fin with a spine, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 鲫鱼
items.form: a deep laterally compressed body, a slightly arched back, a small head, a short blunt snout, a terminal mouth, no barbels, cycloid scales, a complete lateral line
items.fins: a long dorsal fin with a stout serrated spine, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 鳑鲏
items.form: a small body, a small mouth, no barbels at the corners of the mouth, an incomplete lateral line, no ventral keel, a short caudal peduncle
items.fins: a forked tail fin
